WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.translink,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    SUM(cnt) as total_cnt
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.translink,
    s1.tradekind,
    s1.cnt,
    CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total_cnt as ratio
  FROM step1 s1
  JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.tradekind = s2.tradekind
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM step3
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.translink,
    s3.tradekind,
    s3.cnt,
    s3.ratio,
    s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as difference
  FROM step3 s3
  JOIN step4 s4 ON s3.tradekind = s4.tradekind
  WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt,
  AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(difference) as avg_difference
FROM step5
GROUP BY tradekind
